description: The line plot illustrates the performance change, measured by minADE20, as a function of the ratio of the in-context pool size to the total data size. The x-axis, labeled "Ratio," is a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "minADE20 (±)," is also a linear scale ranging from 0.55 to 0.75, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different method: TrajICL (blue line with circle markers), Head Tuning (orange line with circle markers), FT (green line with circle markers), LoRA 16 (red line with circle markers), and LoRA 64 (purple line with circle markers). The TrajICL line starts at approximately 0.75 at a ratio of 0.2 and ends at around 0.60 at a ratio of 1.0, showing a general downward trend. The Head Tuning line starts at about 0.70 and ends near 0.65, also indicating a downward trend. The FT line begins at roughly 0.65 and ends at about 0.55, with a similar downward trend. The LoRA 16 line starts at approximately 0.70 and ends at around 0.60, and the LoRA 64 line starts at about 0.75 and ends at roughly 0.60, both showing a downward trend. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions about the cause of the changes.
